title: OAL error
description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 error object. `message` is one plain sentence shown to people; clients branch on `code`.

code.description: OAL codes: -33001 version_mismatch, -33002 unauthenticated, -33003 pairing_refused, -33004 unknown_agent, -33005 agent_unavailable, -33006 turn_in_progress, -33007 already_answered, -33008 unknown_request, -33009 attachment_failed, -33010 not_permitted, -33011 turn_failed. ACP and JSON-RPC codes pass through unchanged.
